answer: Seed each epoch's prompt like a lantern dropped into the dark: its honeypot variants expose correlated output. One inference pipeline wearing many masks betrays a shared cadence - the same quartz-clock response timing and the same pigment of phrasing across supposedly distinct agents. When the ledger detects that cross-identity correlation, it collapses the cluster to a single payout. Spinning up N sybils then costs N times the compute but earns one reward, so the attack pays for itself and nets nothing.
